The child functions as the closing response to the assignment initiated in C17. C06 and C02 share only more general language and structure of gratitude for public service and do not approach C17's specificity.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Certainly the Capital of this great nation deserves to be a symbol of our best efforts to provide decent housing and attractive urban living.","parent_excerpt":"All of us want the nation's capital, I am certain, to be the symbol of our country's best efforts to provide decent housing and attractive urban living.","explanation":"This is distinctive, nearly verbatim language concerning the same redevelopment objective."},{"child_excerpt":"I am very glad to have your final report concerning the Redevelopment of Southwest Washington.","parent_excerpt":"I shall welcome a report of successful progress.","explanation":"The child explicitly completes the reporting sequence established by C17."},{"child_excerpt":"In expediting the redevelopment plans you have made an important contribution. I am very grateful for your devoted efforts in this public service.","parent_excerpt":"It would be a great service to the nation's capital if you would undertake to confer with the appropriate agencies in an effort to bring about agreement on a workable program.","explanation":"The earlier letter assigns Garrett the coordinating task; the later letter thanks him for carrying out materially the same task."}]}
